assessment_objectives.objective: the Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) for which a Hardware Bill of Materials (HBOM) is required are defined.

a Hardware Bill of Materials (HBOM) is generated for internally produced Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), or obtained from the supplier for acquired TAAS, that lists the hardware components in use.
each Hardware Bill of Materials (HBOM) records a unique identifier (e.g., part number, model or serial number) for each hardware component.
each Hardware Bill of Materials (HBOM) records the version or revision of each hardware component.
each Hardware Bill of Materials (HBOM) records the supplier of each hardware component.
Hardware Bills of Materials (HBOMs) are updated when hardware components are added, replaced or removed.
